subject: Exec onsite expense reconciliation — ancillary fees & card hold
messages:
From: Mariana Soto <mariana@venueco.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom@atlas-sys.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice and incident note — onsite 3/14 (Atlas Systems)

Hi Markus,

Attached is the final invoice for last week's exec workshop at The Elm Room (invoice attached). A couple of incidental items were charged on our corporate point-of-sale after the event: airport parking for one of the client cars and a $75 visa-processing surcharge that the client paid on site. Venue operations flagged the parking charge under a staff code, so it hasn't been billed to Atlas Systems through our portal — we're including it here for reconciliation so your AP has a single package.

Attachments: venue_invoice_AtlasSystems_20260314.pdf

Let me know if you need any extra line items broken out. We can issue a corrected invoice if you want the visa fee listed as an attendee reimbursement instead of a venue incidental.

Thanks,
Mariana Soto
Operations Manager, VenueCo
mobile: (415) 555-0189
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice and incident note — onsite 3/14 (Atlas Systems)

Naomi — can you confirm whether the venue's $75 visa-processing charge and the $42 parking fee should be routed as:

- client-paid reimbursable (billable to Atlas Systems) OR
- internal corporate expense (we cover as a hospitality line)

Client (Tom Reynolds) paid the visa fee on site and wants it back in the same-week payroll run if possible. I've attached Mariana's invoice. Vendor also mentioned the parking charge was coded to their staff account so it might show up separately if they submit a corrected invoice.

Also curious whether the corporate card we used (virtual card ending 7890) was flagged — Lauren, can you confirm the virtual-card status? I had a declined charge when I tried to book an extra cab after the workshop.

Thanks — Markus
Senior Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice and incident note — onsite 3/14 (Atlas Systems)

Markus — thanks for the heads up. Quick answers:

- Visa-processing fee ($75): mark as reimbursable to Atlas Systems. Please have Tom (client) sign/confirm the expense line on the expense report so we have the client authorization in case of audit.
- Parking ($42): treat as vendor incidental; if VenueCo issues a corrected invoice with that line we will bill Atlas. If not, we can absorb as hospitality under account 6201 — let us know preference.

Regarding the virtual card (ending 7890): I've escalated to Procurement. It looks like the card was auto-blocked at 14:12 on 2026-03-14 due to an unusual MCC pattern (multiple small transactions in a short window). That's likely why your cab charge declined. Procurement can either unfreeze it (riskier) or issue a one-off virtual card for specific charges.

I'll open an expedited AP ticket to get the visa fee reimbursed next run if you provide the signed attestation.

—Naomi
Finance Operations
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-16T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice and incident note — onsite 3/14 (Atlas Systems)

Markus — sorry about the declined cab. Procurement confirmed: the hold was automated by the card provider because the sequence of micro-services charges (parking, coffee, cab) looked anomalous relative to the usual workshop spend. They recommended these options:

1) Issue a 48-hour virtual card preloaded with exact amounts for any outstanding vendor charges (preferred for quick fixes).
2) Provide one-off approval to unfreeze the existing virtual card (longer audit trail, slower).
3) Use personal card + fast reimbursement (we can do same-week payroll only if receipts + client authorization are provided by EOD Wed 3/18).

If we want option 1, Procurement needs: vendor name, line item amounts, and a ticket number. Naomi — I see you've opened the AP ticket; can we get a Proc ticket created too?

Also CCing Grace so CS has visibility in case Atlas requests an itemized client invoice.

—Lauren
Head of Sales Operations
From: Tom Reynolds <tom@atlas-sys.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Mariana Soto <mariana@venueco.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice and incident note — onsite 3/14 (Atlas Systems)

Thanks for the quick follow-up. I confirm Atlas would like the visa-processing fee reimbursed to the attendee (Markus) and billed to Atlas. I'm attaching a short signed note confirming the expense and that Atlas authorizes reimbursement.

We prefer Vendor-billed for the parking charge if VenueCo can issue the corrected invoice. If not, bill Atlas and I'll route it through my AP.

Attachment: atlas_authorization_signed.pdf

Tom Reynolds
Director, IT Strategy — Atlas Systems
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Expense actions taken for Atlas onsite (visa + parking)

All — per notes and Tom's confirmation: actions completed:

- AP Ticket #EXP-2026-3147 created and prioritized for same-week processing.
- Reimbursement: $75 (visa fee) set to be paid to Markus (bank on file) on payroll date 2026-03-19.
- Parking $42: VenueCo will reissue corrected invoice; AP will bill Atlas. If we don't receive corrected invoice by 3/20, Redwood will temporarily absorb the charge and invoice Atlas in next monthly statement.
- Procurement issued one-off virtual card (VC-0321) preloaded for a $60 cab allowance and vendor incidentals; it expires 2026-03-20 23:59 PST. That should prevent further declines.

Attachments: visa_fees_receipts_markus_20260310.pdf, boarding_pass_markus_20260314.pdf

If anyone needs the AP ticket link or the Concur draft, here are the links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1rVhExpReport and Concur:EXP-2026-3147.

—Naomi
Finance Operations
